extension.summary: Sync your Silo movies and TV shows into the Kodi library
extension.description: KodiConnectForSilo writes the movies and TV shows on your Silo server into Kodi's own video library, so every skin, widget and library feature treats them like local media. Watched state and resume points stay in step both ways, and playback streams from Silo: the original file when Kodi can play it, a converted stream otherwise. Community project: not made or endorsed by the Silo team.
extension.disclaimer: Do not run Kodi's "Clean library" on Silo items; KodiConnectForSilo manages them itself.
extension.news:
0.25.0: TV page (Skyline 0.16.0): a Catch up row of matches and programmes that have just ended, on channels with catch-up; time left on live cards; On now updates a moment after you watch a channel; Start again for a programme on a catch-up channel.
0.24.0: ratings follow Silo's new 1 to 10 scale: rate with half stars, and a rating reads back on the right line (ratings given from Kodi since the server moved to it went in at half; rate those again). Shows you have started show their episodes left on Home's posters (needs Skyline 0.15.0).
0.23.1: a Continue Watching card no longer stays blank after Kodi starts (its saved picture link had expired); it now loads once the rows refresh, without reloading the skin.
0.23.0: Live TV, as Sky's: Up/Down browse channels in the banner without switching (OK to watch); hold OK for a mini guide of five channels in half-hour columns, back into catch-up and on into the days ahead (needs Skyline 0.14.3).
0.22.0: resuming starts 3 seconds before where you stopped (a Playback setting), and unpausing can rewind a little. With 4K menus it offers to keep posters and backgrounds sharp (Kodi's picture sizes, then a restart). A Silo-style skin can switch the screensaver, its delay, spoiler hiding and theme music volume (now quieter) from its own settings. Dolby Vision's profile comes apart from the badge, for the skin to show or not. Requests' backgrounds take the poster's colour, not green.
